highlights_headline: Backports the Apple 26.0 library TFM update and a WinUI .NET 9 fix to the 3.x line.

bullets.detail: Brings the unversioned app / 26.0 library target-framework split from the v4 line back to 3.119.x for consumers who haven't upgraded yet.
Fixes a WinUI Projection DLL not being found when consumed from .NET 9 apps.
